topology: Minimal base roles, N-8 maintainers, i-th slot assigned to maintainer i modulo (N-8); deterministic fixture with no random task, verdict or payload selection. UUIDs isolate storage.
provider: Same threaded, local synthetic HTTP provider and fixed 50 ms service delay in each paired arm.
admission: Two slots for both arms. Fixed uses both. Adaptive uses the production NF AdaptiveController with actual PG and system observations, polling interval 0.5 s; record every observed target change. Both use actual NF task claims and the same funded slots.
clock: AW request to settled receipt, nearest-rank P50/P95/P99 including backlog. Compare descriptive measurements on the same executor. The pre-existing fixed-single contract remains separately enforced.
